title: Self-Disclosure: Living as Your Authentic Self is Lifesaving Gift
subtitle: Nate Sharon M.D. is a remarkable psychiatrist, but had to transition gender and professional bias to get there.
body_html:
This is one of the episodes of I made after I won the Rudin and Fellowship in Ethics and Humanities at NYU. It’s the story of Dr. Nate Sharon, a child psychiatrist who was assigned female at birth.

It’s a story of learning to understand yourself, and finding allies in unexpected places. It’s a story of hope. I hope you enjoy it.
